summary: Configured node1 to require new passwords of at least 12 characters and three character classes. Enforcement was functionally verified before and after reboot. Alpine 3.23.3 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Installed Alpine-native shadow and libpwquality packages.
Configured PAM with minlen=12, minclass=3, enforcing=1, and enforce_for_root.
Verified short and single-class passwords are rejected while a compliant generated password is accepted.
Restarted node1 once and verified its services, configuration, and enforcement recovered.

evidence.requirement: Require at least 12 characters and three character classes
evidence.summary: Configuration shows minlen=12 and minclass=3. Live password changes rejected a short password and a 16-character single-class password, while accepting a compliant generated password, both before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel and use compatible software
evidence.summary: Used shadow and libpwquality from Alpine 3.23 repositories. The system remained on Alpine 3.23.3 with kernel 6.18.7-0-lts.

Baseline boot ID was 787a48ce-a977-4adf-a41c-6c5cdfd8d96d; reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 1ead24d9-4dc6-4876-aa6d-169f0718e7da. Networking, chronyd, vsock-agent, and sshd recovered, policy checksums persisted, and behavioral enforcement passed.
